company.introduction: HSBC provides banking and financial services to individuals, businesses and institutions, with particularly important franchises in Hong Kong and the UK and extensive international connections. Its services include deposits, mortgages, business lending, trade finance, payments, wealth management and access to capital markets. The bank earns interest on lending and other assets, alongside fees for transactions, advice and managing investments. Its cross-border network is especially relevant to customers moving goods or money between markets. Performance depends on deposit funding, borrowing demand, credit quality and interest rates, while the diversity of its operations brings exposure to different currencies, economies and regulatory systems.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
